entities.name: Elnor
entities.description: Human woman from New Capenna who traveled through an Omenpath to Thunder Junction to confront Yuma.

entities.name: Shadress
entities.description: Elnor's girlfriend, who died of depression.

entities.name: Yuma
entities.description: Former friend who fled with the group's last money and ran a bar on Thunder Junction.

entities.name: Riveteers
entities.description: Group the friends left to start a co-operative.

entities.name: Brokers
entities.description: Faction whose train the group tried to rob.

entities.name: Kirri
entities.description: Cactusfolk who created a new structure with vine magic.

entities.name: Omenpath
entities.description: Planar pathway connecting New Capenna and Thunder Junction.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which Elnor's group formed.

events.summary: After the invasion Elnor, Shadress, Yuma and others leave the Riveteers to found a co-operative.
events.quote: to leave the Riveteers and start their own co-operative

events.summary: Debt, enemies and a failed robbery leave the group poor; Shadress dies and Yuma flees through an Omenpath with the last money.
events.quote: Yuma abandoned the group with the last of its funds

events.summary: Elnor follows through the Omenpath to Thunder Junction and confronts Yuma at his bar with fire.
events.quote: She entered Yuma 's bar with fire literally in her hands

events.summary: Rain and Kirri's cactus magic end the fight; Elnor lets bygones be bygones and leaves with the snake demon.
events.quote: Elnor agreed to let bygones be bygones and left with the snake demon to forge a new life of her own.

relations.quote: Elnor got together with her girlfriend Shadress

relations.note: confronted him over the stolen money
relations.quote: She demanded answers about the money that had been taken
